purpose: Proceduralize repeated manual branch-tip and leaf-fan editing around the first source-owned sapling without changing trunk, flex, donor, environment or weather semantics.
failure_policy: Reject candidates that fail the existing organic-form checks, exceed the retained west-A proxy envelope, lose exact branch attachments, mutate source-owned immutable fields, or fail the minimum material-difference gate. After attempt_limit, return HOLD; never widen bounds automatically.
truth_boundary: This family proves only bounded deterministic variation of already-authored branch/crown degrees of freedom around one stylized sapling source. It does not establish botanical species generation, biological growth, environment/art-direction acceptance, deformation, materials, runtime performance, production readiness, CANON, or procedural-design mastery.
